plugins.description: A persistent, role-based team of eight specialists with per-role memory that compounds across sessions. Adds /cabinet, /cabinet-ensure and /cabinet:process skills plus /cabinet commit; installs SessionStart, Stop, and PostToolUse hooks that load memory, enforce evidence capture, and lint raw entries.
